integrity: The signed-series identity, error exponents, and finite coefficient checks have been examined; numerical windows are explicitly not used as proofs of the infinite assertion.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is asymptotic for each fixed k>=7. Its proof uses the classical uniform Gelfond exponential-sum estimate and proves no effective eventual-monotonicity threshold. Six summands remain unresolved. Equivalence to an unindexed result cannot be ruled out; no independent review has been performed.
title: Seven summands suffice for eventual strict growth of evil and odious representation counts
